title: CORAL-KV: Compact Cross-Layer Prediction and Residual Coding for Autoregressive Video KV Caches
abstract: arXiv:2610.12514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models maintain a growing attention key-value (KV) cache, making memory a key bottleneck for long video generation. Recently, clustering-based quantization has emerged as an effective method to compress video KV caches by grouping similar key and value vectors then quantizing residual errors. However, when later frames attend to the compressed history, small reconstruction errors can compound as the video grows. Beyond the within-layer similarity exploited by clustering, we find strong dependencies across cache layers in video models. This motivates Coral-KV - Calibrated Offline, Residual-coded, and Adapted Locally - a KV-cache compression framework that uses cache states in each layer to predict keys and values in subsequent layers, then quantizes the remaining prediction residuals. We construct compact block-diagonal-plus-low-rank (block-DPLR) predictors: block-diagonal components model channel relation

translated_title: CORAL-KV：面向自回归视频KV缓存的紧凑跨层预测与残差编码
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12514v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：自回归视频扩散模型维护着持续增长的注意力键值缓存，使内存成为长视频生成的关键瓶颈。近来，基于聚类的量化已成为压缩视频KV缓存的有效方法，它通过将相似的键和值向量分组、再量化残差误差来实现压缩。然而，当后续帧关注被压缩的历史内容时，微小的重建误差会随视频变长而不断累积。除了聚类所利用的层内相似性之外，我们发现视频模型的缓存各层之间存在强烈的跨层依赖关系。这促使我们提出Coral-KV——离线校准、残差编码、局部自适应——一个KV缓存压缩框架，它利用每一层的缓存状态来预测后续层的键和值，然后对剩余的预测残差进行量化。我们构建了紧凑的块对角加低秩预测器：块对角分量建模通道关系……
tldr: 提出Coral-KV框架，利用视频模型KV缓存中强烈的跨层依赖关系，通过紧凑的块对角加低秩预测器跨层预测键值并对预测残差进行量化，从而在自回归长视频生成中高效压缩KV缓存并抑制重建误差随视频增长而累积的问题。
en_tdlr: Coral-KV exploits strong cross-layer dependencies in video model KV caches by using compact block-diagonal-plus-low-rank predictors to predict keys and values of subsequent layers and quantizing the residuals, enabling efficient KV cache compression with reduced error accumulation for autoregressive long video generation.
